name: cols
sql: select column_name, data_type from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='ten216_test_odds_changes' order by ordinal_position

name: size
sql: select pg_total_relation_size('public.ten216_test_odds_changes') total_bytes, (select count(*) from public.ten216_test_odds_changes) n_rows, (select avg(pg_column_size(t.*))::int from (select * from public.ten216_test_odds_changes order by id desc limit 5000) t) avg_row_bytes

name: per_hour
sql: select date_trunc('hour', observed_at) h, count(*) n, count(distinct poll_id) polls, count(distinct match_key) matches, count(*) filter (where change_kind='first_seen') first_seen, count(*) filter (where change_kind='changed') changed, count(*) filter (where change_kind='removed') removed from public.ten216_test_odds_changes where observed_at > now() - interval '8 hours' group by 1 order by 1

name: per_hour_ml
sql: select date_trunc('hour', observed_at) h, count(*) n from public.ten216_test_odds_changes where observed_at > now() - interval '8 hours' and market = 'Home/Away' group by 1 order by 1

name: markets
sql: select market, count(*) from public.ten216_test_odds_changes where observed_at > now() - interval '6 hours' group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 12

name: last_poll
sql: select max(observed_at) last_row, count(distinct poll_id) filter (where observed_at > now() - interval '1 hour') polls_1h from public.ten216_test_odds_changes

name: damm_betfair_at
sql: select observed_at, selection, price, prev_price, change_kind from public.ten216_test_odds_changes where match_key='12165854' and market='Home/Away' and bookmaker='Betfair' order by observed_at

name: damm_bfe_rec
sql: select book_updated_at, seen_at, back_home, back_away, lay_home, lay_away from ten287_rec.ticks where event_id=74753338 and book='Betfair Exchange' order by book_updated_at

name: pairs_at
sql: select match_key, observed_at, selection, price from public.ten216_test_odds_changes where match_key in ('12165986','12166000','12166007','12165577','12165884') and market='Home/Away' and bookmaker='Betfair' order by match_key, observed_at

name: pairs_rec
sql: select e.event_id, e.home, e.away, t.book_updated_at, t.back_home, t.back_away, t.lay_home, t.lay_away from ten287_rec.ticks t join ten287_rec.events e using (event_id) where t.book='Betfair Exchange' and t.event_status='pending' and ((e.home ilike '%Mannarino%') or (e.home ilike '%Brooksby%') or (e.home ilike '%Marozsan%') or (e.home ilike '%Medvedev%') or (e.home ilike '%Wong%')) and e.start_at > now() - interval '1 day' order by e.event_id, t.book_updated_at
